elements.title: Robust Continual Pose Estimation

figure.caption: Accumulated pose estimation performance showing stable trajectory and rapid recovery compared to baselines.

bullets: Maintains stability over 3.6km routes from a single initial pose
Resists significant drifts caused by dynamic objects and moving vehicles
Rapidly recovers and self-corrects upon encountering distinct landmarks

builds.audio_segment: The system maintains stable navigation over three-point-six kilometers from just one initial pose.
This stability is demonstrated over long routes, starting from only a single initial pose.
It resists drifts from moving vehicles and dynamic objects that often compromise baseline methods.
Furthermore, it uses a rapid recovery mechanism to self-correct at landmarks, ensuring reliable performance for GPS-denied autonomous driving.
